title: Slice commit titled with the Git section's text

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Observed 2026-11-12 (slicer s457): ork's slice commit 51bbad95 is titled "One commit on the slice branch.", the body of the slice's Git section, instead of a title naming the change (earlier slices got e.g. "changelog: per-slice entries in landed-changed/, assembled at release"). Wanted: take the commit title from the implementer's report or the slice title, never from a Git section that carries no title.

Evidence (checked 2026-11-18):

- slicer's s457 Git section is the one line "One commit on the slice branch." (`slicer show s457`), and `git log -1 51bbad95` in slicer prints that line as the subject.
- `sliceCommitTitle` uses the Git section whenever it is not blank (`internal/engine/title.go:17-26`). `ParseGitTitle` takes the first double-quoted text, else the first non-blank line (`internal/engine/title.go:28-43`). So a Git section that only describes the commit becomes the title.
- The first-line rule is tested on purpose: `TestParseGitTitle` (`internal/engine/approve_test.go:190-208`) and the "plain" case of `TestCommitTitleFallsBackToIDAndTitle` (`internal/engine/approve_test.go:226-260`). S139 added the "ID: title" fallback for an empty Git section only.
- ork's own specs quote the title (S419: 'message "S419: prints-nothing Check lines pass on a no-match exit"'), which the quoted rule already reads.

Open owner question: what an unquoted Git section gives, per the owner's answer to `git.commit-title`. The spec below is written for the recommended answer: only a quoted title counts; otherwise "ID: title".

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/title.go:15-43` (`sliceCommitTitle`, `ParseGitTitle`)
- `internal/engine/approve_test.go:190-260` (`TestParseGitTitle`, `TestCommitTitleFallsBackToIDAndTitle`)
- `internal/engine/states.go:1253-1256` (the `commit` doc comment)
- `docs/design.md` (the commit step: where the title comes from)
- `docs/guide.md` (writing a slice's Git section)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `internal/engine/approve_test.go`:

- `TestCommitTitleIgnoresAnUnquotedGitSection`: a harness slice "S04" titled "Engine" whose Git section is "One commit on the slice branch." commits with title "S04: Engine" (the fake git route expects `commit -m "S04: Engine"`). Red today: the title is "One commit on the slice branch." (`internal/engine/title.go:37-41`).
- `TestCommitTitleKeepsAQuotedGitTitle`: Git section 'One commit on the slice branch, message "S04: engine core".' commits with "S04: engine core". Green today; it guards the quoted rule.
- `TestParseGitTitle`: drop the two unquoted cases that expect a first line; an unquoted body returns no title and no error, so the caller falls back. Red today: those bodies return their first line.
- `TestCommitTitleFallsBackToIDAndTitle`: the "plain" case now expects "S04: Engine". Red today.
- `TestApprovePausesWhenTheSliceHasAnExplicitEmptyGitTitle` stays as it is: an explicit empty quoted title still pauses.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests and see each red for the stated reason.
2. Per the owner's answer to `git.commit-title`. For the recommended answer: `ParseGitTitle` returns the first double-quoted text; with no quoted text it returns "" and no error. `sliceCommitTitle` falls back to "ID: title" (S139) when the Git section is blank or holds no quoted text. An explicit empty quoted title still pauses, as today.
3. Update the `commit` doc comment (`internal/engine/states.go:1253-1256`) to say "the quoted title of the slice's Git section".
4. Docs: `docs/design.md` (commit step) and `docs/guide.md` (a Git section names its title in double quotes; anything else gives "ID: title"). Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S357 --text "..."`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A slice whose Git section has no double-quoted title is committed as "ID: title".
- A quoted title in the Git section is still the commit title.
- An explicit empty quoted title still pauses the run at the commit step.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/engine -run 'TestCommitTitle|TestParseGitTitle|TestApprovePausesWhenTheSliceHasAnExplicitEmptyGitTitle' -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, message "S357: commit title only from a quoted Git title".
